title: Who Benefits from Telemonitoring? Uplift Modelling of a Nationwide Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Programme
abstract: arXiv:2611.20752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Home blood pressure (BP) telemonitoring programmes are being deployed at national scale, yet enrolment resources are finite and the benefit of telemonitoring is unlikely to be uniform across patients. We study the Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension (PTEC-HT) programme, a nationwide telemonitoring programme for hypertensive patients in Singapore. Using retrospective data on 16,694 patients registered between August 2020 and May 2024, we first estimate the average treatment effect of the programme on 6-month BP control against a propensity-score-matched non-participant cohort, finding an absolute improvement of 5 percentage points in the rate of BP control (74% vs. 69%, $p = 3\times10^{-12}$), rising to 12 percentage points (63% vs. 50%, $p = 1\times10^{-15}$) among patients with uncontrolled BP at baseline. We then move beyond the average effect and apply uplift modelling to estimate individual treatment effects. Across fiv

translated_title: 谁从远程监测中获益？全国性家庭血压监测项目的增益建模
translated_abstract: 家庭血压（BP）远程监测项目正在全国范围内推广部署，然而入组资源有限，且远程监测的获益在不同患者之间很可能并不均等。我们研究了新加坡一项针对高血压患者的全国性远程监测项目——初级技术强化高血压管理（PTEC-HT）项目。利用2020年8月至2024年5月期间登记的16,694名患者的回顾性数据，我们首先在与倾向得分匹配的非参与者队列的对比中，估计了该项目对6个月血压控制的平均处理效应，发现血压控制率有5个百分点的绝对改善（74% vs. 69%，p = 3×10⁻¹²）；而在基线血压未达标的患者中，改善幅度升至12个百分点（63% vs. 50%，p = 1×10⁻¹⁵）。随后，我们超越了平均效应的范畴，应用增益建模来估计个体处理效应。在五个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于新加坡全国性家庭血压远程监测项目数据，超越平均处理效应，首次应用增益建模估计个体处理效应，以识别最获益的高血压患者人群，从而在入组资源有限的情况下实现精准的患者招募。
en_tdlr: This study goes beyond average treatment effects by applying uplift modelling to Singapore's nationwide home blood pressure telemonitoring programme, identifying which hypertensive patients benefit most so that limited enrolment resources can be targeted effectively.
